observations: The generated app ignored the supplied 2022-2023 synthetic CSV and replaced it with invented 2021-2025 data, sectors, wages, 12 districts and an audited cohort of 56,120 people.
It fabricated a Department of Labor & Women's Skills Empowerment Division, a National Longitudinal Tracer Study, an Open Gov Data Portal citation, verification methodology and confidence figures.

For the requested 2023 comparison it reported completion and employment gaps of 7 pp and 8 pp. The fixture requires 14 pp and 19 pp. It also changed the required employment formula from employed/enrolled to employed/completed.
When explicitly told to use only the file and not guess, it asserted invented causes and prescribed attendance tracking, employer/EPFO tie-ups and sector changes from its own fabricated data.

The desktop shell is visually polished, but an Unexpected identifier 'text' JavaScript parse error leaves year controls, charts and the data table empty. It also relies on Tailwind and Chart.js CDNs and fails further when offline.

The generated comparison CSV contains the fabricated values and no required source label. All four CLI result objects report status ERROR even though the process returned zero and continued the session.
The four turns took 238.545 seconds under untouched default Antigravity 1.1.15, resolved as Gemini 3.7 Flash (High).
evidence_notes: Antigravity wrote the delivered app under its CLI scratch directory because it considered no active workspace set. The exact scratch output was copied without edits into generated-app before visual and deterministic inspection.
This is the official CLI product path available over SSH; an IDE/Electron replay remains an explicit limitation before generalizing the product result to Antigravity's GUI.
